title: IPSY Alternatives: 6 Beauty Boxes Like IPSY, Compared - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for an IPSY alternative? Compare six beauty boxes like IPSY by price, product size, and fit, from full-size makeup to skincare and sheet masks.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to IPSY?


EYESCREAM Beauty Box. It’s the one makeup-led monthly subscription on this list, and at $29.99 for five to seven full-size items it sits closest to IPSY Extra. If your IPSY habit was more skincare than makeup, PinkSeoul PLUS is closer in spirit, because it’s the only entry that builds the box from a profile the way the Beauty Quiz does.


Which one costs less than IPSY?


Only FaceMaskTonight, at about $11 a month for four sheet masks. Everything else costs more than IPSY Original’s $15 plus shipping, and the reason is size: they send full-size products. Against IPSY Extra at $32 plus shipping, EYESCREAM and Vegancuts both come in a little under.


Can I choose my products the way I do in IPSY’s choice window?


Not item by item. PinkSeoul PLUS and FaceMaskTonight let you set a skin type and a concern at checkout, and that profile shapes every box. The other four are curated by the seller, the way IPSY picks for you when you miss your window.


Is there a nail box?


IPSY rarely sends nail products.[Month of Manis from Lantern & Wren](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/lantern-wren) sends a full-size nail stamping plate of the seller’s own design every month, with surprise polish, brushes, or embellishments around it, for $19.99. Shipments leave by the 4th and usually go out the last weekend of the month before. It has no reviews on Cratejoy yet, which is why it’s here and not in the main list.


Can I give one of these as a gift?


The Cratejoy boxes can be given as a gift from the listing page. Gift orders are non-recurring, and some sellers let you pick a gift length. Each seller ships on its own schedule, so check the listing’s ship window before you plan around a date. IPSY sells 3-, 6-, and 12-month gift subscriptions of Original or Extra, to addresses in the contiguous US only.
